firstLines: I'm applying for the Executive Assistant position at Calder & Wright. I've worked as an administrative
assistant for seven years, most recently supporting three partners and a team of 12 advisers at Halvorsen
My job is to make sure the people I support never have to think about their calendars, travel or paperwork.
At Halvorsen I manage three partners' schedules, prepare client meeting packets and process about 80
expense reports a month. Last year I set up a simple shared request form that replaced most of the
scheduling emails, and the partners noticed the difference within a week.
I'm careful with confidential information and calm when the day changes at the last minute, which I
understand happens often at a law firm.
Thank you for considering my application. I'd be glad to meet at a time that suits you.
